description: Helps you decide how to find more accounts like your best ones. You give your ICP's company profile, technologies, champion titles and buying triggers, and optionally what you sell and the platforms you use. You get targeting criteria and search queries for each platform, one signal for each trigger, and search keywords from what you sell and the sector. It writes criteria, not data: it finds no companies or contacts. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of icp_deep_dive when you already have an ICP and need search criteria and trigger signals.

buying_triggers.description: Events that trigger buying. Format is a JSON array. For example, ["upcoming audit"].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "upcoming audit".

champion_titles.description: Job titles of your champions. Format is a JSON array. For example, ["finance director"].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "finance director".

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

icp_firmographics.description: Firmographic criteria. Format is a JSON object. For example, {"industries":["manufacturing"],"company_sizes":["200 to 500 employees"],"locations":["India"]}.

company_sizes.description: Format is a JSON array. For example, ["200 to 500 employees"].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "200 to 500 employees".

funding_stages.description: Format is a JSON array. For example, ["series-a"].

industries.description: Format is a JSON array. For example, ["manufacturing"].

locations.description: Format is a JSON array. For example, ["India"].

icp_technographics.description: Technologies your ICP typically uses. Format is a JSON array. For example, ["existing accounting system"].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "existing accounting system".

platforms.description: Optional: the sections to include (linkedin, google_ads, 6sense, zoominfo). Left out, every section is included. Format is a JSON array. For example, ["linkedin"].

product_category.description: Optional: what you sell (for example "spend management software"), used for search keywords and sector notes. Format is text.

name: lookalike_signal_generator
title: Lookalike Signal Generator
